_about: External evaluation corpus: PyPI project pages.
_why: The primary corpus is this repository, which documents its own evaluation - so golden questions leak into it and are quarantined, and the eval measures a progressively smaller corpus. This corpus has no relationship to the repository and cannot contain its questions.
_license: Page text is authored by each project's maintainers; see the source URL.
_robots: Each URL was checked against pypi.org/robots.txt before fetching.

_template_removal.why: PyPI project pages carry their download table, per-file hashes, attestations and release history inside the main content area, so a single-page extractor keeps them. They were 90.9% of this corpus, and IDF is computed over that text.
_template_removal.how: scrape/boilerplate.py: a heading present in at least half the documents from one host is that host's template; its section is dropped down to the next heading of the same or a higher level.
